title: Coefficients coordinates for smooth purity
statement: Use [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting], [def-pur-conventions], [sk-def-sfb-constructible], [def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. Fix a prime $\ell$. A coefficient presentation is one of: a finite commutative ring $A$ killed by $\ell^{n+1}$ ($n\ge0$), $\mathbf Z_\ell$, $\mathbf Q_\ell$, the valuation ring or field of a finite subextension of the fixed $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, or that algebraic closure. Its condensed ring is respectively continuous functions into the discrete finite ring, the integral or rational topological ring, or the existing finite-subextension-valued closure. Write $R_{c,X}=p_X^*R_c$ on the small pro-etale site and $D_c(X)=D(\operatorname{Mod}_{R_{c,X}})$. Its constructible finite-Tor subcategory is the recorded finite-constant-model subcategory. The canonical map $\mathbf Z_\ell\to R_c$ gives $L_{c,X}=R_{c,X}\otimes_{\mathbf Z_{\ell,X}}\mathbf Z_{\ell,X}(1)$, where the integral line is the existing root-tower limit. Define $L^{(0)}=R$, $L^{(d+1)}=L^{(d)}\otimes_R L$, $T_c(d)=L^{(d)}[2d]$, and $J_{f,c,d}=Lf_c^*(-)\otimes^L T_c(d)$. All rings, coefficient maps, categories and lines are these actual constructions.
